messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: PAGER (sev=2) - inference-service: increased 5xx rate in us-west-2. Pager duty: @Sam on-call. See /incidents/1768001234 for details.

Sam: on it, joining now. grabbing logs and will triage.

Sam: quick status - 5xx spikes started ~12:02 UTC. Appears to be a cache invalidation job triggering a surge in cold starts. Customers might see failed generation or timeouts ~12:02-12:12.

Devlin: joining. can you paste the failing stack? also what's impact scope (hosted vs dedicated vs private)?

Sam: pasted snippet from logs: ```
E 12:03:11 inference-server: RuntimeError: kvcache miss + OOM fallback triggered
E 12:03:11 worker-23: failed 502 to client 10.12.4.5
```

Sam: impact: primarily hosted API instances in us-west-2. Dedicated pools unaffected so far. Private deployments obviously unaffected. Estimated affected customers: ~120 active API keys, mostly low-volume dev/test.

Izzy: tagging marketing — we should draft a status page message and a short external note if this persists >30m. Also prepping social messaging if it reaches broader visibility.

Nina: product note - any customer-facing SLA exposure? If only hosted and limited to dev keys, probably not hitting enterprise SLAs but we should still be transparent.

Oliver: legal/PR check - if we push a public statement, avoid language implying data loss. Confirmed there are no data breaches. If we say 'partial service disruption' that's fine.

Izzy: draft status page update (short):

```
Status: Degraded Performance
Components: Redwood API (us-west-2 hosted)
Start time: 2026-06-18T12:02:00Z
Details: We are investigating increased 5xx error rates affecting hosted API customers in the us-west-2 region. Some requests may return errors or experience higher latency. Dedicated and Private deployments are not impacted.
Next update: in 15 minutes or when we have more information.
```

Sam: +1 for that language. please include that our teams are mitigating and rollback of recent cache invalidation job is in progress.

Izzy: updated status page blurb:

```
Status: Degraded Performance
Components: Redwood API (us-west-2 hosted)
Start time: 2026-06-18T12:02:00Z
Details: We are investigating increased 5xx error rates affecting hosted API customers in the us-west-2 region. Some requests may return errors or experience higher latency. Our engineers are mitigating the issue; we are rolling back a recent cache invalidation job. Dedicated and Private deployments are not impacted.
Next update: in 15 minutes.
```

Devlin: looks good. can we add a non-actionable suggestion for customers on the status page? e.g., retry/backoff guidance.

Izzy: added: "If you are seeing errors, please retry with exponential backoff. If errors persist, contact support with request IDs."

Sam: handoff note - I need to get off-call in 25m. can the next oncall keep monitoring error rate and confirm rollback success? I'll tag in the incident channel with runbook steps.

Devlin: I'll take over after Sam. going to validate rollback and watch metrics for next 30m.

Izzy: external customer notification draft (for mailing list / customers affected):

```
Subject: Brief outage affecting hosted API in us-west-2 (June 18)

Hi —
We experienced a partial service disruption impacting the Redwood hosted API in the us-west-2 region beginning at ~12:02 UTC on June 18. During this time some API requests returned errors or experienced higher latency. Our engineers identified a cache invalidation job causing increased cold starts and rolled back the change. Dedicated and Private deployments were not impacted.

If you saw errors, please retry your requests and reach out to support with any persistent failures and request IDs. We apologize for the inconvenience and will follow up with a post-incident summary.

Thanks,
The Redwood Inference Team
```

Oliver: wording looks safe. minor edit: remove 'partial service disruption' -> use 'degraded performance' to be consistent with status page.

Izzy: updated the mail: changed to 'degraded performance' and added link to status page.

PR-bot: Reminder: any public post requires PR review with comms + legal signoff. Please upload drafts to PR #3124.

Izzy: uploaded drafts to PR #3124 and added @Oliver for legal and @Nina for product signoff.

Devlin: rollback verified at 12:18 UTC, 5xx rate returning to baseline by 12:26. I'll keep an eye until 12:50.

Sam: thanks — leaving now. handing to @Devlin.

Devlin: monitoring - error rate at baseline. marking incident as mitigated in internal tracker.

Izzy: since mitigation confirmed, proposed social message (X/Twitter short thread) — two variants: one factual and one empathetic.

Variant A (factual):
"Service update: We experienced degraded performance for hosted API customers in us-west-2 starting at 12:02 UTC. The issue has been mitigated; we rolled back a cache invalidation job. No customer data was exposed. Full details: [status.redwood.ai/incidents/1768001234]"

Variant B (empathetic):
"We're sorry for the disruption earlier today to hosted API users in us-west-2. Our team rolled back a change causing increased errors and service is back to normal. Thanks for your patience — details: [status.redwood.ai/incidents/1768001234]"

Oliver: both fine. prefer Variant B for our social timeline. it's friendlier and reduces defensive tone.

Nina: product agrees with Variant B. quick ask — can we pin the status link and add a short thread reply with steps for devs (retry/backoff + support contact)?

Izzy: will post Variant B once we have PR approval. adding a reply with developer guidance.

PR-bot: PR #3124 opened by Izzy at 12:38 UTC. Required reviewers: @Oliver, @Nina.

Oliver: approved at 12:43 UTC. Nina: approved at 12:44 UTC.

Izzy: publishing tweet now and updating status page: posting Variant B. pinned status link and replied with dev guidance.

Devlin: closing note - internal comms template for support team: short blurb + copy-paste for support replies. I've added to the internal incident doc.

Sam: thanks team. good runbook follow.

Izzy: follow-up: we'll prepare a post-incident summary with root cause and remediation steps by EOD tomorrow. I'll draft and circulate for review. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED - inference-service (us-west-2). Duration: 00:24:00.
